name: Galestorm
description:
Upon Hero kill, gain a 20% boost to movement speed, for 10 seconds. 

Must land killing blow to activate.
explanation: This perk is decent, and an alternative to other perks due to its generic usefulness on many assassin heroes. Helps rotations from one finished fight to the next, although executing the opponent eats into the duration of the buff.

name: Devourer
description:
Executions heal an extra +10 HP. 

Healing occurs at the kill time of the execution.
explanation:
This perk is especially good on heroes with strong dash heavies who can punish rolls (e.g Warden, Shaman, PK). 

Synergizes extremely well with Remedy and Head Hunter, providing Shaolin and Shaman a potent perk setup. 

Has extra value on heroes with executions that have quick kill times. Post-nerf it heals the same amout as Remedy, making it strictly worse than that perk.

name: Early Reaper
description:
Upon spawn or revive, your next attack deals 30% extra damage. 

Applies to chip damage from blocked attacks, landed attacks, and damage dealing feats - against heroes or soldiers.
explanation:
This perk is awful, as is its logical equivalent, Crush Them, as they both have a small single use benefit that isn't even guaranteed to work.

The best use is to boost the damage of high damage ranged feats, which can be easier to hit off spawn when you arrive at a fight.

name: Endurance
description:
Gain a 3% stamina cost reduction per renown level. 

Maximum 12% stamina cost reduction at max renown.
explanation:
This perk is decent, and is an acceptable alternative to Head Hunter due to its generic utility. Great for characters who use zones or high stamina moves in their 4v4 gameplay.

Note: Does not stack with the feat: tireless.

name: Survival Instinct
description: When in critical health ( <25 HP), gain a 25% stamina cost reduction.
explanation: This perk is very underwhelming, and encourages you to attack when you are low on HP, a situation where you would rather be turtling up to obtain revenge.

name: Crush Them
description:
Upon Hero kill, your next attack deals 30% extra damage.

Applies to chip damage from blocked attacks, landed attacks, and damage dealing feats - against heroes or soldiers.
explanation: This perk is awful, as is its logical equivalent, Early Reaper, as they both have a small single use benefit that isn't even guaranteed to work. The best use is to boost the damage of high damage ranged feats, immediately after a kill, like a worse version of Bloodlust.

name: Head Hunter
description: For each unique Hero executed, maximum health is increased by +4 HP to a maximum of +16 HP.
explanation: This perk is decent, and is an acceptable alternative to Endurance. Synergizes extremely well with Remedy and Devourer to give you increased value out of execution healing.
